title: Outdoor sand sculpture viewing
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Visitor notice | Larch Bay Sand Day
This year's sculptures will stand on low platforms in the sand. A yellow cord marks the public route; a blue cord marks the work area for teams repairing sculptures. The yellow route will remain open even while some teams are working. Wooden viewing mats are available at the west entrance for visitors who prefer a firm surface.

The shapes of three entries look very different from their two marked sides. For those entries, every visitor vote has two boxes: choose the side you looked from, then mark the shape you liked. You do not need to look from both sides. If rain blurs a viewing mark, a steward will point to the correct viewing spot; do not stand inside the blue cord to make the shape easier to recognize.

The west platform will be repaired at noon. The public route still reaches it from the east. Its west viewing mark will be covered by a temporary board, but the steward beside the mat can still direct visitors to both marked sides from the public route. A steward will collect paper votes at the exit; we will not collect votes inside the marked work area.
passageZh:
文件 1｜遊客公告｜落葉松灣沙雕日
今年的沙雕會放在沙地裡的低平台上。黃色繩索標示遊客動線，藍色繩索標示各隊修補沙雕的工作區。即使有參賽隊還在作業，黃色動線也維持開放。若希望走在較硬的表面上，可在西側入口使用木製觀覽墊。

三座參賽沙雕從標示的兩側看，形狀差異很大。這三座作品的票上都有兩個要填的欄位：先選你從哪一側看，再標記你喜歡的造型。你不必從兩側都看過。如果下雨讓觀覽位置的標記模糊，引導員會指出正確的觀覽點；不要為了更容易辨認造型而站到藍繩內。

西側平台會在中午進行修補。遊客動線仍可從東側通往該處。西側的觀覽位置標記會被臨時木板蓋住，但觀覽墊旁的引導員仍能指示遊客從公開動線前往兩側的觀覽點。出口會有引導員收紙本選票；工作區內不收票。
